name: Floquet effective Hamiltonian derivation and analysis
definition: This workflow family involves setting up a time-periodic Hamiltonian, applying Floquet theory (via exact diagonalization, high-frequency expansion, or degenerate perturbation theory) to derive an effective static Hamiltonian or quasienergy spectrum, and then using that to compute observables or dynamics of the driven system.

skeleton.purpose: Specify the system and driving parameters to obtain a time-periodic Hamiltonian H(t) with period T=2*pi/omega.
Select the appropriate Floquet method based on driving frequency and amplitude regime.

skeleton.step_name: Construct effective Floquet Hamiltonian or Floquet matrix
skeleton.purpose: Obtain a time-independent representation that generates stroboscopic dynamics.
Obtain the quasienergy spectrum and corresponding Floquet states.
Use Floquet states to compute time-averaged or stroboscopic quantities.

evaluation_protocol: Validate against exact numerical Floquet evolution for small systems; compare stroboscopic dynamics, quasienergy spectra, and observables; check convergence with truncation or time-step parameters.
